entities.name: Krešimir Lončar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Krešimir Lončar is a Croatian former professional basketball player, currently working as manager of sport & scouting for s.Oliver Würzburg of the Basketball Bundesliga. Standing at 2.10 m, he played both the power forward and center positions.
